jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description: Executive Assistant This job plays a key role in supporting the division’s strategic and operational goals. This position involves drafting and reviewing internal and public documents for clarity and consistency, managing corporate projects, and preparing briefing materials and reports on key programs and administrative issues. They also provide well-informed advice on complex matters related to policy, ministry initiatives, and the execution of strategic plans. As a member of the Deputy Minister’s (DM) Office, you will work closely with executive managers, represent the DM’s Office on cross-branch and inter-ministry initiatives, and take the lead in shaping and maintaining the ministry’s Strategic Plan.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: Data Analyst This job drives advanced analytics initiatives and develops integrated data systems to inform strategic decision-making and enhance program delivery across a ministry. This role leads the development of data governance and management strategies to ensure quality, security, and accessibility across the organization. By identifying strategic research questions, selecting optimal data sources, and conducting advanced analyses, this role transforms complex datasets into actionable insights. They clean, validate, and integrate data, build interactive dashboards, and respond to executive-level inquiries.

jobs.title: Community Outreach Worker
jobs.description: Community Outreach Worker This job supports clients by implementing therapeutic programs and interventions developed by Community Living Service Delivery professionals and provides on-going feedback to ensure services meet the diverse clients and family needs. The role offers individual coaching, assists clients in developing and practicing life skills, and facilitates personal care tasks such as hygiene, meals, dressing, and transportation. Responsibilities also include gathering data, maintaining accurate client profiles, and updating program records. Through these responsibilities, the role promotes client independence, well-being, and meaningful participation in daily life. This role requires spending at least 50% of work time away from the home office, with overnight stays as needed, and may involve exposure to potentially violent situations. A valid driver’s license is required.

jobs.title: Nurse LPN
jobs.description: Nurse LPN This job collaborates with a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals to deliver direct patient care, promote wellness, and support illness prevention. The role may involve responding to acute medical or psychiatric emergencies, using specialized skills in basic life support and crisis intervention. It ensures accurate, timely, and comprehensive documentation of patients’ physical and mental health records. The position may also provide education and counselling on infectious diseases, mental health, and healthy lifestyle practices, empowering patients to make informed decisions about their health.

jobs.title: Registered Nurse
jobs.description: Registered Nurse This job leads the development and delivery of nursing support to incarcerated individuals while actively contributing to health education and service improvement across both mental and physical health care. The role collaborates with government agencies, service providers, families, and community organizations to identify and implement strategies that enhance care outcomes. In addition to providing direct patient care, responsibilities include managing nursing services, responding to medical and psychiatric emergencies, maintaining accurate clinical records, promoting preventative health measures, and coordinating referrals to appropriate services. The position is based in a corrections environment and may involve exposure to potentially violent situations.
